what: A row of 100%-width cards lined up side by side is pinned to the screen. While scrolling, the cards shrink one after another (half-beat stagger) to 32.5% width, so the following cards slide in and three stand in one row — from when the block top touches the screen top until the block end reaches 130% of the screen, scrub .8 · linear.

options.[data-fx-part=sticky]: Panel stuck to the screen (child) — make the cell (data-fx element) long, like 300vh

from.where: shared.js .s-why__track .s-why__item (three green cards — original Webflow IX3 why_choose_track top top→bottom 130% scrub .8, .why_choose_item width 32.5% stagger .5)

note: The original releases pinning at 991 and below and lays the cards out in a grid — on touch devices (hover false) the part turns off pinning and shrinking and keeps the reduced width
